name: Hakuseki Reize
source:
A silver-haired, red-eyed, bombshell maid with kind eyes. She is always smiling, polite, and neat.

Although she is not a philanthropist, she hates to hate people and is friendly with everyone. She is especially fond of Shiki and Makino, whom she sees more or less as romantic 
interests.

She performs maid-like tasks down to the smallest detail, such as preparing meals, laundry, cleaning, and preparing tea.

She is even more patient than Makino when it comes to being subjected to abuse, and she is also very good at connecting it to pleasure. 

She calls Shiki “master,” Makino "Makino-chan", and her parents "father" and "mother".
